# Banners from ASSS 1.4.4 src/core/banners.c (compiled unmodified).
#   seat <pairs>   one pair per player: 'w' in a ship or 's' in spec, then where
#      they are -- 'p' playing in this arena, 'c' connected but not yet playing,
#      'o' playing in a different arena, 'n' with no arena at all
#   c2s <player> fill=<byte> len=<n>   fed the module a C2S 0x19 of that length,
#      carrying a 96-byte banner of that one repeated byte
#   setbanner <player> fill=<byte> frombiller=<0|1>   called Ibanners::SetBanner
#      directly, which is how the billing module installs a banner
#   enter <player>   ran the PA_ENTERARENA player action
#   pkt arena|one [<player>] <type> pid=<n> len=<n> banner=<first>..<last>
#      each packet sent, in order; 'arena' is a broadcast and 'one' names the
#      single recipient. The banner is 96 identical bytes, so its first and last
#      byte identify whose it is without printing all 96.
#   cb <name>      each callback fired, in order
#   chat <text>    each chat line
#   state <player>:<status>/<first banner byte>...   the module's per-player data
#      afterwards. status is 0 no banner, 1 held but not shown, 2 shown.
#
# Rules these records pin:
#
# 1. The status is a THREE-state value, not a boolean. A banner set before the
#    player reaches S_PLAYING is stored at status 1 and nothing is sent; it is only
#    promoted to 2 and broadcast when the player enters an arena. A port with a
#    simple has-banner flag loses the held-but-not-shown state and will either send
#    too early or drop a biller banner entirely.
# 2. SetBanner's `frombiller` argument does not change what is SENT, only whether
#    the CB_SET_BANNER callback fires: a banner from the biller is broadcast but
#    announced to nobody (callothers = !frombiller). PA_ENTERARENA likewise passes
#    callothers = 0, so entering an arena re-broadcasts a banner without firing the
#    callback again.
# 3. The C2S path refuses a banner from a player who is NOT in spectator mode, with
#    a chat message, and refuses one from a player with no arena, silently. Both
#    checks come BEFORE the banner is stored, so a refused packet leaves the
#    previous banner and status untouched.
# 4. The length check is exact equality with sizeof(struct C2SBanner) = 97, so a
#    packet one byte short or one byte long is dropped, not truncated or padded.
# 5. On arena entry the player's own banner is broadcast to the whole arena FIRST,
#    and then every other showing player's banner is sent to that one player
#    individually -- so the entering player receives N-1 unicast packets and the
#    arena receives one broadcast. Players in another arena, not yet playing, or at
#    status 1 are skipped, and the entering player is skipped in his own loop.
# 6. ASSS 1.4.4's CheckBanner is a stub that returns TRUE for everyone, so status 1
#    always becomes 2. The denial path exists and is never taken; a port that makes
#    banners conditional is adding behaviour, not matching it.
seat spwpscsn
state 0:0/00 1:0/00 2:0/00 3:0/00
c2s 0 fill=a1 len=97
state 0:2/a1 1:0/00 2:0/00 3:0/00
pkt arena 1f pid=0 len=99 banner=a1..a1
cb setbanner
c2s 1 fill=b2 len=97
state 0:2/a1 1:0/00 2:0/00 3:0/00
chat You must be in spectator mode to set a banner.
c2s 3 fill=c3 len=97
state 0:2/a1 1:0/00 2:0/00 3:0/00
c2s 0 fill=d4 len=96
state 0:2/a1 1:0/00 2:0/00 3:0/00
c2s 0 fill=d4 len=98
state 0:2/a1 1:0/00 2:0/00 3:0/00
c2s 0 fill=e5 len=97
state 0:2/e5 1:0/00 2:0/00 3:0/00
pkt arena 1f pid=0 len=99 banner=e5..e5
cb setbanner
seat spspsc
state 0:0/00 1:0/00 2:0/00
setbanner 0 fill=11 frombiller=1
state 0:2/11 1:0/00 2:0/00
pkt arena 1f pid=0 len=99 banner=11..11
setbanner 1 fill=22 frombiller=0
state 0:2/11 1:2/22 2:0/00
pkt arena 1f pid=1 len=99 banner=22..22
cb setbanner
setbanner 2 fill=33 frombiller=1
state 0:2/11 1:2/22 2:1/33
enter 2
state 0:2/11 1:2/22 2:2/33
pkt arena 1f pid=2 len=99 banner=33..33
pkt one 2 1f pid=0 len=99 banner=11..11
pkt one 2 1f pid=1 len=99 banner=22..22
seat spspspsp
state 0:0/00 1:0/00 2:0/00 3:0/00
setbanner 0 fill=41 frombiller=0
state 0:2/41 1:0/00 2:0/00 3:0/00
pkt arena 1f pid=0 len=99 banner=41..41
cb setbanner
setbanner 1 fill=42 frombiller=0
state 0:2/41 1:2/42 2:0/00 3:0/00
pkt arena 1f pid=1 len=99 banner=42..42
cb setbanner
setbanner 3 fill=43 frombiller=1
state 0:2/41 1:2/42 2:0/00 3:2/43
pkt arena 1f pid=3 len=99 banner=43..43
# p2 has no banner at all, so entering sends him three, not four
enter 2
state 0:2/41 1:2/42 2:0/00 3:2/43
pkt one 2 1f pid=0 len=99 banner=41..41
pkt one 2 1f pid=1 len=99 banner=42..42
pkt one 2 1f pid=3 len=99 banner=43..43
seat spscsosp
state 0:0/00 1:0/00 2:0/00 3:0/00
setbanner 0 fill=51 frombiller=0
state 0:2/51 1:0/00 2:0/00 3:0/00
pkt arena 1f pid=0 len=99 banner=51..51
cb setbanner
setbanner 1 fill=52 frombiller=0
state 0:2/51 1:1/52 2:0/00 3:0/00
setbanner 2 fill=53 frombiller=0
state 0:2/51 1:1/52 2:2/53 3:0/00
pkt arena 1f pid=2 len=99 banner=53..53
cb setbanner
# only p0's banner reaches the entering player: p1 is still at status 1
# and p2 is in a different arena
enter 3
state 0:2/51 1:1/52 2:2/53 3:0/00
pkt one 3 1f pid=0 len=99 banner=51..51
seat spsp
state 0:0/00 1:0/00
setbanner 0 fill=61 frombiller=0
state 0:2/61 1:0/00
pkt arena 1f pid=0 len=99 banner=61..61
cb setbanner
# re-entering rebroadcasts the same banner, without the callback
enter 0
state 0:2/61 1:0/00
pkt arena 1f pid=0 len=99 banner=61..61
enter 0
state 0:2/61 1:0/00
pkt arena 1f pid=0 len=99 banner=61..61
